scan_semantics: At scan k, sample every input once, read retained pre-state q[k], execute one transition, and observe outputs O[k] at the end of that same scan. Updated state becomes q[k+1]. Reset the instance before each test. Step 0 executes normally; initial conditions describe pre-state, not an extra delayed scan. All timing in this task is explicitly counted in invocations, not wall time.
safety_priority: Trip, missing request and invalid Preset clear progress

formal_properties.explanation: Healthy scans increment and saturate precisely.
The indication agrees with the post-scan count.
A perpetually valid request qualifies within at most five scans, even if valid Preset varies.

atomic_propositions.Request: Raw qualification request Boolean names are propositions; numeric names appear only inside defined predicates.
atomic_propositions.Trip: Immediate inhibit Boolean names are propositions; numeric names appear only inside defined predicates.
atomic_propositions.Preset: Required consecutive scans, valid 1 through 5 Boolean names are propositions; numeric names appear only inside defined predicates.
atomic_propositions.Ready: Qualified request Boolean names are propositions; numeric names appear only inside defined predicates.
atomic_propositions.Count: Saturated consecutive scan count Boolean names are propositions; numeric names appear only inside defined predicates.
atomic_propositions.first: True only on the first invocation after resetting the FB instance.
atomic_propositions.qualified: Count >= Preset and Preset is valid.
atomic_propositions.nextCount: min(qCount+1, Preset) as an integer expression.
